scripts.build:models: npm run models:deps && npm run models:blender && npm run models:pack
scripts.models:deps: test -d tools/blender/.vendor/numpy || uv pip install -q --python $(blender -b --python-expr "import sys;print('PYV',sys.version_info[0],sys.version_info[1],sep='.')" | sed -n 's/^PYV\.//p') --target tools/blender/.vendor numpy
scripts.compare: uv run tools/compare/compare.py --model refs/out/iphone-18-pro.dev.glb --label after --measurements tools/measure/models/iphone-18-pro/measurements.json --config tools/compare/iphone-18-pro.json --rectified-dir refs/out --out refs/out/compare/after && uv run tools/compare/report.py
